nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances in UniswapExchange; mutated in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding spend approvals; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sale occurrences, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) granting whitelisted addresses a bypass of the sales limit checks in ensure.
Private uint256 minimum sale amount, set by init and read by condition.
Private uint256 maximum sale amount, set by init and read by condition.
Private uint256 cap on the number of sales per address, set by init and read by condition.
Address granted a whitelist bypass in ensure and set by the owner-only setTradeAddress.
Private privileged address assigned in the constructor; used for access control checks in ensure, delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply, initialized once in the constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used in init and constructor scaling multiplies.
Constant Uniswap router address that is whitelisted in the ensure() permission bypass.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate keeping sale restrictions; returns true for the owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale whitelist, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transfer path performing raw unchecked balance arithmetic and allowance decrement, then calling ensure().
Public payable approval writer; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no return-value semantics.
Internal view validating _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimal scaling multiplication.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and updates balances in a loop without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter that assigns the whitelisted tradeAddress used in ensure().
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 for the token.
Payable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, minting the full supply and setting an infinite UNI allowance.
Private SafeERC20 helper executing a low-level call to a token contract and decoding the returned boolean.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, caller identity in transfer/approve and allowance keying.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate() executed with the contract's own storage and context.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn performing an external contract call.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend allowing overflow.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend (no SafeMath).
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom() and ensure().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Target contract address parameter of delegate() for the delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate() for the delegatecall.
Sale count parameter of init().
Minimum token amount parameter of init().
Maximum token amount parameter of init().
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress().
Loop counter in batchSend().
Local variable holding _value * _tos.length in batchSend().

edges.reason: Parameter _to flows into transfer() as the recipient.
Parameter _value flows into transfer() as the amount.
msg.sender is used as the _from address in transfer().
transfer() invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom() arithmetic and checks.
Parameter _from indexes balanceOf/allowance inside transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared against _from and used to key allowance in transferFrom().
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass.
Parameter _from feeds the ensure() whitelist and condition logic.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the pair address whitelist entry.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() requires condition(_from, _value) when not whitelisted.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] to skip restriction checks.
ensure() grants a bypass when _from equals the privileged tradeAddress.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale to check the minimum amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to check the maximum amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve() sets allowance keyed by msg.sender.
Parameter _spender is the approval target in approve().
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate().
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-influenced inputs.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale configuration.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token scales into _minSale in init().
Parameter maxToken scales into _maxSale in init().
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
Parameter _tos is iterated as the recipient list in batchSend().
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend().
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend() reads and credits the balanceOf mapping in a loop.
Local loop counter i controls the batchSend() distribution loop.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before assignment.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() mutates the privileged tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the full supply to the deployer.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
Constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router.
Constructor initializes totalSupply from the supplied amount.
callOptionalReturn() performs address(token).call(data) as a low-level external call.
The low-level token call can re-enter callOptionalReturn()/its caller before state settles.
The attacker-controlled delegatecall executes arbitrary code in the contract context and re-entry is possible.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed transfer(); fold it into the transfer function node.
The amount parameter is defined by and only meaningful for transfer(); merge into the transfer node.
The source parameter is the transferFrom operand used by its balance/allowance logic; merge into transferFrom.
The spender parameter is only used as the approve key; merge into the approve node.
The target address parameter only feeds the delegate() delegatecall; merge into delegate.
The calldata parameter only feeds the delegate() delegatecall payload; merge into delegate.
The sale count parameter is only stored by init(); merge into init.
The min amount parameter is only scaled into _minSale by init(); merge into init.
The max amount parameter is only scaled into _maxSale by init(); merge into init.
The recipient array parameter is only iterated by batchSend(); merge into batchSend.
The address parameter is only assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress(); merge into setTradeAddress.
The loop counter is a local artifact of the batchSend distribution loop; merge into batchSend.
The local total holds the unchecked _value * _tos.length product; merge into the total_mul unsafe operation node.
